messages.subject: Taking a break and a chance FOR YOU to win a prize!
parts:
Dear all,

Given that I have been responding to over 90% of the questions in this google group, it may be good to clarify that I am not an AI but a real person.

I am taking a break now during the holiday season. Next, I will likely be very busy with GGIR training in January (there are still a few more seats available!), and after that I will be taking another break from 26 January to 16 February. So, there is a fair chance that I will not have time to look at all the new messages before the 17th of February.

While I am gone, please try to help each other where possible.

Even if you do not know the answer to a question, it will be of massive value to both the person posting the question and to me if you could:
  • Help that questions are clearly formulated and specific with if possible example files and example code.
  • Check that the answer is not in the GGIR documentation or in the google group message history.
If you know the answer to a question, please also try to propose how GGIR documentation or functionality can be improved to avoid similar questions in the future.

The person most active in helping the google group community in the upcoming months will win a free 90 minute online consultancy session with me. If more than one person makes a major effort, I will consider giving the prize to two persons.

Happy Holidays,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
